title: Best Workout Apps to Pair with Your NZ Gym Membership
meta_desc: Discover the best workout apps to pair with your NZ gym membership, including free and paid options
intro: With many NZ gyms offering memberships from $15-$30 per week, such as Anytime Fitness and Jetts, supplementing your gym routine with a workout app can be a great way to stay motivated and reach your fitness goals. Les Mills On Demand is a popular option, priced at $14.95 per month. Many Kiwis are turning to workout apps to enhance their gym experience and track progress.

sections.heading: Free Workout Apps
sections.body: There are many free workout apps available that can be used in conjunction with your NZ gym membership. These apps often include a range of workouts, from yoga and Pilates to strength training and cardio. Some popular free workout apps include Nike Training Club and JEFIT.

sections.heading: App and Gym Membership Price Comparison
Getting the Most Out of Your Gym Membership and Workout App
sections.body: To get the most out of your gym membership and workout app, it's essential to find a combination that works for you. Consider your fitness goals, budget, and preferences when choosing a gym and workout app. Many gyms, such as Les Mills, offer free trials or discounts for new members, so it's worth shopping around to find the best deal.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.body: Supplementing your NZ gym membership with a workout app can be a great way to enhance your fitness routine and reach your goals. With many free and paid options available, there's something to suit every budget and preference. Consider visiting the Les Mills website to learn more about their gym memberships and Les Mills On Demand workout app.
